text: Program Description Program Objectives This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. The courses taught in English of this major offered by the School of Economics. Major Courses This program is offered in English as the sole medium of instruction.
